name: Boulton Center for the Performing Arts

evidence.note: Business listing describes a 261-seat stadium-style theater in the former Regent movie theater.
Reviews praise sloped seating where every seat sees the stage; none mention dancing.
Venue home page lists upcoming concerts and stresses that every seat is close to the stage.

dancing.notes: All seats are fixed theater seats on a sloped floor, and we found no dance area. Plan on a seated concert.

description: A small theater of about 260 seats in an old movie house on Bay Shore's Main Street, run with the YMCA. It hosts concerts, tribute bands and comedy.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03).
